title: Run both proof-tier conformance tests after heap and Gson changes
description: Check the conformance corpus on the source that binds nullable application arrays, executes the JDK collection wrappers and preserves the runtime class named by new. Exercise native, integrated JBMC, auto-selection and confirmation, checking reference verdicts and original witnesses.
expected: Both tests pass on the qualified source with no new JVM-contradicted verdict.

steps.name: Both conformance proof-tier tests
